translationRepairs: In 211, when Guanzhong fell into chaos, Liu Kuo of Fufeng fled into Hanzhong, bought Shan, learned he came from a respectable family, and raised him as his own son, marrying him off and fathering a grandson.

In 211, when Guanzhong fell into chaos, Liu Kuo of Fufeng fled into Hanzhong, bought Shan, learned he came from a respectable family, raised him as his own son, gave him a wife, and Shan fathered a son.
The subject of 生一子 is Liu Shan: Liu Kuo arranged his marriage, after which Shan had a son. The existing wording incorrectly makes Liu Kuo father the child.
candidateDispositions: Jian is the county visited by the Later Lord.
